Oracle Fusion Project Management 26C: what changed

We track 23 Project Management changes in 26C, out of 23 features (our count) in Oracle's 26C What's New documents for this area. 3 of them are delivered switched on; 20 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Delivered switched on (3)

Automatic Creation of Rebills when Canceling Invoices

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProject ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
Cancel and rebill project contract invoices with a single action. Rebill invoices contain the same invoice lines and transactions as the original invoice when the cancel and rebill invoice action is initiated without performing any transaction-level adjustments, thereby allowing adjustments as needed on the rebill before resending them to the customer.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Labor Commitment Reporting in OTBI

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProject ManagementProject Management · Cost Management and Control
Leverage Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, or OTBI, to report on labor commitment information for project planning and control. Labor commitment reporting helps you analyze future labor commitments and related cost distributions so you can validate project spend, review commitment liquidation, and manage labor-related project costs more efficiently.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Milestone Approval History

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Project ManagementProject Management · Planning, Scheduling, and Forecasting
Enable project managers to view a detailed approval history for each milestone, including status changes, initiators, approvers, and timestamps for all approval actions.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (20)

Data Extraction Using Read-Only Replicated Data

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Management Common
Extract data with improved reliability and speed, with less impact on core application performance. The simplified extraction experience includes support for full or incremental extracts, on-demand runs or schedules, and status monitoring.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Optional Ship-To Account and Site Through Configurable Contract Line Validations

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
Two new contract line validations let privileged users make the ship-to account and ship-to site optional on project contract lines, by changing them to Warning or turning them off. By default they're still required.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Program Performance Advisor

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Performance Agents
Drive program success with AI-enabled program analysis and actionable plans. Oracle AI helps uncover program-specific trends and generates actionable recommendations, empowering data-driven decision-making and optimizing program execution.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Program Progress Summary Generator

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Performance Agents
Reduce time spent on report writing with AI-powered summaries for project programs. Generative AI automatically drafts summaries highlighting key achievements, insights, and recommendations.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Billing and Revenue Event Creation Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOpt-inProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Helps users create recurring invoice and revenue events for eligible external fixed-price contracts through a guided conversational experience. The assistant validates the contract or contract line, billing frequency, event type, contract line dates, contract line amount, and existing event details.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In · Oracle source

Project Capitalization Analyst

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Investigate project capitalization issues through a guided, conversational experience. Project accountants can review pending capitalization costs for a project, narrow large result sets by business dimensions such as transaction source, task, or expenditure type, and diagnose why selected project cost transactions didn’t generate asset lines.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Change Order Initiation Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOpt-in plus setupProject ManagementProject Management · Project Planning Agents
Leverage generative AI to create a change order from a project issue. For issues that need a change order, using the information available in the issue, the project manager can now create a change order effortlessly.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In plus Setup · Oracle source

Project Change Summary Generation Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOpt-in plus setupProject ManagementProject Management · Project Planning Agents
Create a comprehensive summary of a project change order with a single click. The summary highlighting the impact of the change order on the project financials helps align stakeholders with project updates and eases approvals.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In plus Setup · Oracle source

Project Contract Bill Transactions Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
An AI assistant that finds, reviews and summarizes project bill transactions by project, contract, status or date range. Users need the assistant's role in AI Agent Studio.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Contract Invoicing Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
The Project Contract Invoicing Assistant enables you to search and review invoices by business unit, customer, contract number, and status. It also allows you to process invoices to Released status after review and create cancel credit invoices for original standard invoices.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Contract Validation Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Validate project contracts by checking delivered and custom validation rules, providing resolution details, and enabling corrective action using the Project Contract Validation Assistant .
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Contract and Customer Purchase Order Reconciliation Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Reconcile project contracts with attached customer purchase order documents by comparing key attributes and identifying mismatches so corrective action can be taken.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Contract and Sales Order Reconciliation Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Reconcile project contracts with attached sales orders by comparing key attributes and identifying mismatches so corrective action can be taken. This automated reconciliation helps reduce contract approval cycles, accelerate funding, and achieve faster invoicing and revenue recognition.

Project Cost Adjustment Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Perform project cost transfer adjustments for individual transactions using natural language prompts. Transfer costs across projects, tasks, awards, and funding sources, and adjust attributes such as cost type and project role.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Cost Exceptions Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Identify and analyze unprocessed project cost exceptions using natural language requests. The assistant streamlines exception investigation and resolution by summarizing and categorizing exceptions and proposing resolution options for each type of exception.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Financial Control Agents

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control Agents
Gain clear insight into project costs, capitalization, and billing to improve financial oversight and keep projects aligned with business objectives. With the Project Financial Control Agents, project teams can quickly understand cost distribution flows and monitor financial progress through guided, conversational interactions.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Performance Agents

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Performance Agents
Improve project oversight with timely performance insights and guided analysis throughout the project lifecycle. Project Performance Agents analyze project performance data in the background and surface proactive insights when defined conditions are met.

Project Planning Agents

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Planning Agents
Accelerate project delivery by transforming business inputs into execution-ready project plans, adapting to change faster, and enabling more informed planning decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

Project Planning Workspace for Project Initiation and Budget Planning

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Planning Agents
Accelerate project delivery with faster project initiation and governed budget planning using the Project Planning Workspace. Initiate projects from Statements of Work, Requests for Proposal, sales opportunities, or natural-language prompts.

Impact on upgrade: lowOpt-in plus setupProject ManagementProject Management · Project Planning Agents
